subject: Azure Partner Center: seller ambassador onboarding & referral mapping for BBox Analytics
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Lee <hannah@bboxanalytics.com>, partnercenter@microsoft.com
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 30 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Azure Partner Center: seller ambassador onboarding & referral mapping for BBox Analytics

Hannah / Partner Center team —

Following up from last week's marketplace sync: BBox is ready for Partner Center referrals but we need to lock the field seller alignment and a simple onboarding for the internal "seller ambassador" who will own co-sell coordination. Attached is a first-pass account mapping (BBox_account_map_v1.csv) and the Partner Center referral template we usually submit.

Two asks to unblock the referral intake: 
1) Can Microsoft confirm the owner mapping rules you'll apply when you run the referral ingestion? Specifically: if a seller is listed as a "regional owner" vs. "primary contact" how will that appear in the intake?
2) Hannah — please confirm which BBox contact should be the canonical sales owner in our CRM so our mutual action plan aligns (we currently have Maya R. listed as the primary).

If easier, we can run a 20-min call this week to walk the mapping and save back a cleaned CSV for PC ingestion. Proposed times: Tue 10:00-10:30 PT or Wed 15:00-15:30 PT.

Thanks —

Jordan Blake
Partner Motion Lead, Growth
Redwood Inference
[jordan.blake@redwood.com]

Attachments: BBox_account_map_v1.csv (CSV, 48 KB); Azure_PC_referral_template.docx (DOCX, 120 KB)

From: Hannah Lee <hannah@bboxanalytics.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: partnercenter@microsoft.com, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 31 May 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Azure Partner Center: seller ambassador onboarding & referral mapping for BBox Analytics

Hi Jordan —

Thanks for the note and the files. Confirming: Maya Rao (m.rao@bboxanalytics.com) should be the canonical sales owner in your CRM. She'll be the primary POC for commercial and co-sell cadence.

We're good to do the walkthrough — Tue 10:00 PT works for me. In terms of the ingestion flags: we want the file to contain a single owner_email column and an owner_role column with values {"primary","regional","technical"}. Our intake service will pick owner_email when present; if owner_email is blank we fall back to the regional owner matching by tenant. I'll add a comment to the template to make that explicit.

Hannah Lee
Head of Partnerships
BBox Analytics

Cc: Hannah Lee <hannah@bboxanalytics.com>
Date: Tue, 01 Jun 2027 08:25:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Azure Partner Center: seller ambassador onboarding & referral mapping for BBox Analytics

Jordan / team —

Thanks Hannah, good clarity. Quick notes from ops after reviewing your CSV: 
- There are ~18 accounts in the sheet that don't have tenant IDs. We should avoid sending those until we can confirm tenant match to avoid duplicate PC referrals.
- I'll clean the owner_role values to the {primary, regional, technical} set and produce a "for ingestion" file. Expect BBox_account_map_v1_clean.csv in my Share once we finish.
- For the seller ambassador onboarding, I suggest the following mini-checklist for the call:
  * Confirm canonical owner_email column and sample tenant mapping for 5 accounts
  * Walk PC template fields that trigger consent (we need explicit owner_email present to auto-create owner consent)
  * Agree on fallback: if owner_email is missing we'll set owner_role=regional and route to the regional owner alias; partnercenter will escalate if no regional match found

I'll own producing the cleaned CSV and will sync the final before ingestion. Jordan — can you own updating our mutual action plan in the shared drive to reflect Maya Rao as the POC?

Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Partner Ops Manager
Redwood Inference

Date: Wed, 02 Jun 2027 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Azure Partner Center: seller ambassador onboarding & referral mapping for BBox Analytics

All —

Great progress. Per Vanessa's checklist, I reviewed the cleaned sheet in Share and confirmed the tenant IDs are now populated for the 18 previously-missing rows. Action items I assigned in the mutual action plan (updated doc link below):
- Vanessa: finalize BBox_account_map_v1_clean.csv and upload to the shared folder (target: EOD Thu 6/3)
- Jordan: update MAP to show Maya Rao as seller ambassador + updated contact info (target: Wed 6/2 EOD) — DONE
- Hannah: confirm she has visibility in her CRM and will monitor consent flows once ingestion runs (Hannah replied in call that she will)

Related links: https://redwood.app/shared/drive/BBox-account-map — I added a version note and the ingestion timestamp.

I'll set a calendar reminder for Thurs 6/3 10:00 PT to check post-ingestion statuses and any consent issues. If Partner Center ingestion reports any mismatches we'll triage immediately.

Karthik Iyer
Director, Partner GTM
Redwood Inference
